title: Punjab Local Government Third Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Third Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 19th June, 2002]
No.Legis.13-59/2000/P-IV,
dated 19-6-2002.-- The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of
the Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Local Government
(Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Third Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment in section 116 of Ordinance XIII of 2001

PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 19th June, 2002]
No.Legis.13-59/2000/P-IV,
dated 19-6-2002.-- The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of
the Punjab is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment in section 116 of
Ordinance XIII of 2001.--In the said Ordinance, in subsection (3) of
section 116, full stop at the end shall be substituted by a colon and
thereafter the following proviso shall be added:
"Provided that the
Government may, as a matter of general policy, issue directions to all or any
of the Local Governments to exempt the levy of any tax for such period and on
such conditions as may be specified."
